description: Click an element on the page by CSS selector or accessible label. Use this to interact with buttons, links, checkboxes, and other clickable elements.

button.description: Mouse button to click with. Default: "left".

click_count.description: Number of clicks (e.g. 2 for double-click). Default: 1.

label.description: Accessible name or visible text to click by. Alternative to selector.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click. Either selector or label is required.

wait_after_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after clicking before returning.

name: click
